before.cause: An external page-scroll event can run the still-registered onScroll close callback during popover blur/Tab exit. close unconditionally focuses the opener, so it overrides the newly focused next control.

change: Outside scroll now dismisses only a still-open popover without unconditionally focusing its trigger. The existing toggle handler restores the opener only when focus remains inside/body. Tab can keep focus on its next outside control; explicit Escape, option selection and resize retain their existing opener behavior.

userScopeDecision.instruction: Don't check200% zoom or windows below1280×720; do those later.
userScopeDecision.historicalEvidence: The four earlier-size keyboard journeys completed before this instruction. Their dated results remain private history; no smaller/enlarged check was rerun after the instruction. The current driver only runs1280×720 at normal zoom.

method.application: Current production renderer/preload plus actual source-bundled main/services/storage, protected dummy account, hidden muted native window. Shared Keychain/provider adapters substituted and external fetch blocked.
method.keyboard: Keyboard Enter opens filters after focusing their named trigger. ArrowDown/End move among loaded choices; Escape restores visible trigger focus. External page scroll dismisses while focus is inside and restores the opener. Tab exits to Tag without jumping back to Genre. Search/Enter selects Jazz and focuses the updated trigger.
method.dialogsAndDetours: Keyboard opens queue and Escape returns to its trigger. ArrowRight switches News bucket tabs. Source/DJ management and Back retain draft mood/interests and focus the relevant management button. Native DJ dialog retains focus through12 Tab presses and Escape returns to New DJ. Confirmed dummy-source deletion removes its opener and focuses Sources heading. Provider-key return uses the enabled Settings-tab fallback when preparation is disabled.
method.layout: At1280×720 normal zoom, setup Save is focused and visible, with no horizontal document overflow. The settled native webContents capture was inspected; player controls remain visible below the scrolled setup. This is not an all-page/VoiceOver or user-comprehension claim.
method.cleanup: Final baseline driver terminates zero; each owned native close checks absence of captured fatal output. Owned localhost server stops and its control file resets. Zero provider calls.
